mcp.description: NVIDIA Cosmos3-Nano robotics augmentation for LeRobot v3: transfer/V2V, numeric actions preserved; physical fidelity unproven. Clips16–400 frames; bundles≤5GiB. Download output_manifest public artifact UUIDs, not logical worker labels.

limitations: Qualification covers the retained release150 public MCP uploaded-bundle two-variant blur-transfer dataset, exact nonvideo records and full LeRobot0.6.1 reopen. Valid data and distinct variants do not prove semantic intent, physical action alignment or multi-view synchronization. Final customer cohorts, other source paths and maximum bounds are separate gates.

Appearance augmentation preserves numeric actions, state, timestamps and canonical indices, not proven physical/action alignment. Transfer retains coarse layout; video-to-video may alter trajectories. Inspect output before training.

Selected clips:16–400 frames, integer FPS1–30, RGB256..1280 by256..720 dimensions divisible by16; at most256 selected episodes,8 selected cameras and8 variants. Untouched clips are checked for dataset integrity, not generation caps.

Compressed input/each output≤5GiB; expanded source≤8GiB;32GiB workspace with conservative pre-GPU estimate and2GiB reserve. Fixed-rate canonical timestamps/task ordering are required; no maximum-bound throughput qualification.
Forward/inverse dynamics and policy-model rollout are unsupported. Source action trajectories are preserved; episodes longer than400 frames need a separately qualified chunk/stitch contract.

Recorded-data writer successor normalizes scalar storage to declared singleton shape without changing numeric values. Exact published CPU coordinator reopened two episodes/128 frames and preserved all 6144 nonvideo values using retained successful H100 child videos.

The legacy h100_semantic_receipt field here identifies explicitly scoped CPU-coordinator plus retained-H100-child evidence, not fresh whole-public-path qualification. New image is active/unqualified until public completion and scheduler receipts are captured.
Old release150 acceptance describes its historical image only and is not inherited by this successor. No new snapshot, physical motion fidelity or maximum-bound throughput qualification is claimed.
